bias.en: Rebound failing · lost the 10 and 100-day after a reversal from $555
bias.zh: 反弹受挫 · 自 $555 回落，失守 10 日和 100 日均线

read.en: AMD fell 7.7% on Nov 19 to $489.19, reversing from $555.01 to $470.56 on heavy volume (1.89x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($512.2), 10-day ($517.2, rising), 30-day ($529.2) and 100-day ($526.0), and above the rising 200-day ($428.6). MACD has been above its signal since Nov 11, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($459.96), and RSI is 45.2.
read.zh: AMD 11月19日下跌 7.7%，收于 $489.19，盘中从 $555.01 回落至 $470.56，成交量放大（为 20 日均量的 1.89 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$512.2）、10 日（$517.2，上行）、30 日（$529.2）和 100 日均线（$526.0）下方，守在上行的 200 日均线（$428.6）上方。MACD 自 11月11日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 11月10日起看多（$459.96），RSI 为 45.2。

read.en: The $555.01 high briefly topped the Nov 11 close ($552.90), but the close lost the $520–527 and $501–509 supports, now resistance, and held the $480.5–488.8 band. Resistance is $501.3–504.3, then $512.2–517.2 (5 and 10-day) and $526–532.2 (100 and 30-day, Nov 18 high). Support is $480.5–488.8, then $470.6 (Nov 19 low) and $460 (SAR). A close above $504.3 would target $512–517; below $480.5, $460–470.6.

r.en: Nov 16 low $501.30; Nov 17 close $503.41; Nov 16 close $504.28
